title: Saddharmapuṇḍarīka Chapter 2 similarity matrices and reproducibility audit (transcriptions excluded)
description:
Original Chapter 2 similarity matrices and an independent reproducibility audit supporting Yasutomo Nishi's ASCJ 2027 research: 33 manuscript witnesses plus a KN reference row. Includes 24 unchanged original CSV exports, numerical audit reference results, generic character mapping, manifests, documentation and audit scripts.

SMSR II transcription texts and all 12 text-specific legacy restoration annotation files are excluded because redistribution permission has not been obtained. Recalculation requires lawfully obtained external private inputs. The public release alone cannot reproduce the text-based scores. The earlier v1.0.0 archive contains transcription text and its files have been restricted; the old GitHub history is private.

Component licences: original CSV exports — CC BY 4.0 with Chihiro Mayuzumi's permission (confirmed by the depositor on 10 October 2026); credit Mayuzumi as creator and Nishi as curator. Audit scripts — MIT, copyright (c) 2026 Yasutomo Nishi. Nishi's original documentation, metadata, numerical audit results and generic encoding mapping — CC BY 4.0. See RIGHTS.md and directory LICENSE files. No licence for SMSR II text is granted.

Previous audit: G3 and G5 each reproduce 406 positive exported pair scores in legacy font units. Ten other units remain unresolved under the uniform baseline. Twenty-two ranking order inversions are preserved in original exports; numerical rankings are separate results.
notes: CC BY 4.0 applies to matrices and original documentation/metadata/numerical audit results/generic encoding mapping; scripts/ are MIT.
